correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructed for every integer n>=2: complementary Beatty indicators give an exact positive-index convolution; direct fractional-part interval analysis gives all three phases; Fibonacci-denominator block counts plus Zeckendorf decomposition give interval discrepancy O(log n) uniformly for moving intervals; irrational-rotation equidistribution yields the pushforward law, atom, mean and liminf/sup. Endpoint boundaries cannot occur at the relevant irrational rotation phases and are harmless. Exact integer convolution to 8192 and independent literal-pair enumeration to 2048 agree. Finite tests are not used as infinite proof.

A uniform explicit O(log n) approximation and the nondegenerate continuous-plus-atomic law distinguish the frequency of typical linear-size representation counts from sparse special Fibonacci/Lucas exceptions.
